Completed assessments with zero scores remain completed; summary totals stay independent of table search and pagination.

Compact History tables and read-only historical detail views using each form's familiar layout.

Compatibility and conflict checks protect existing schedules and reported financial actuals during saves.

Partial saves retain the unsaved schedule entries; uncertain saves are checked before retrying to avoid duplicate activities.
